text:
elaine: need a tiny migration doc for v1->v2: focus on embedding model swaps and the SDK param rename. one-page, two snippets, PR by Friday.
pj: I can draft the TL;DR and bullets.
sam: Ill author TS + smoke test. show guard by embedding dim and fallback to pinned model. keep it minimal.
kris: Ill do the Python snippet and add an assertion for dim. runtime note: it will NOT convert vector dims; reindex or pin models.
elaine: wording: 'we recommend reindexing or pinning model IDs in production' - legal ok with 'recommend'.
pj: banner draft: "Deprecation: /v1/models removed 2026-04-15. Embedding dims may change on model swap; we recommend reindexing or pinning model IDs."
sam: TS sketch:
```ts
const meta = await client.models.get('my-embed-v2')
if (meta.embedding_dim !== EXPECTED_DIM) {
  await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'my-embed-v1', input: ['hi'] })
} else {
  await client.embeddings.create({ model: meta.id, input: ['hi'] })
}
```
kris: py sketch:
```py
meta = client.models.get('my-embed-v2')
if meta['embedding_dim'] != EXPECTED_DIM:
    vec = client.embeddings.create(model='my-embed-v1', input=[text])
else:
    vec = client.embeddings.create(model=meta['id'], input=[text])
assert len(vec[0]) == EXPECTED_DIM
```
